```sh
kafka scram set <users...>
```

Create or update a SCRAM credential for one or more users

## Arguments

| Argument   | Description                          |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `users...` | user names to set the credential for |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Requires an explicit mechanism and password input. PBKDF2 iterations default to 4096.

## Before you run

Creates or rotates authentication material. Coordinate client credential rollout to avoid disconnecting users, and retain a secure credential recovery path.

## Flags

| Flag                    | Description                                                   |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`    | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092              |
| `--mechanism <string>`  | scram-sha-256 or scram-sha-512                                |
| `--iterations <number>` | PBKDF2 iteration count (defaults to 4096, the broker minimum) |
| `--password-stdin`      | read the password from stdin — never accepted as a plain flag |

## Examples

```sh
kafka scram set alice --mechanism scram-sha-256 --password-stdin --brokers localhost:9092
```
